The 12 hour T Bezel combines an elapsed hour timer (or a second time zone tracking) with both countdown and elapsed minute timers, which everyone needs. Specifications NH35 automatic movement (hacking, hand-winding) 316 stainless steel case (optional Black PVD) 40mm diameter · 12.8mm thick · 48.5mm lug-to-lug 20mm lug width 200m / 20 ATM water resistance (pressure tested) Sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating BGW9 lume (hands, indices, bezel) 144g / 5oz Laser-etched branding on crown, clasp, and caseback. watches.name: Gen 2 Shooting Watch w/ Rangefinder
watches.description: Marksman Shooting Watch – Rangefinder Edition A mechanical tool watch built specifically for long-range shooters. This version adds a logarithmic rangefinder bezel and chapter ring system that allows you to estimate distance, calculate wind, and convert MILs to MOA—without electronics. What It Does Range targets using MIL or MOA Convert angled wind into effective crosswind Translate MIL ↔ MOA in real time Supports: - Metric (cm / m / MIL) → read at 12 o’clock - Imperial (in / yd / MOA) → read at 10 o’clock - Sniper mixed system (in / m / MIL) → read at 4 o’clock (actually at 20.5 minutes ~4 o'clock) - American hunter mixed system (in / yd / MIL) → read at 22.5 minutes Dial & System Crosswind multiplier scale built into dial MIL-to-MOA quick reference inner track Logarithmic rangefinder bezel + chapter ring system Designed for use with MIL or MOA reticles, in real shooting conditions Specifications NH35 automatic movement (hacking, hand-winding) 316 stainless steel case (optional Black PVD coating) 40mm diameter · 12.8mm thick · 48.5mm lug-to-lug 20mm lug width 200m / 20 ATM water resistance (pressure tested) Sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating BGW9 lume (hands, indices, bezel) 144g / 5oz Laser-etched branding on crown, clasp, and caseback. Custom engraving available for orders of 10 or more. Build & Kit Screw-link bracelet (no pins) Toolless micro-adjust clasp Included screwdriver for sizing Zippered travel puck case (no fancy box) First Setup Unscrew crown, pull out one click and set the time Push crown back in and wind ~50 turns (cannot overwind) Apply blue Loctite to bracelet screws or ensure they are snug Screw crown down tightly to maintain water resistance Shipping & Warranty This watch has just started production. Allow 4-5 weeks for delivery. May ship direct from Hong Kong or via U.S. routing Covered by 1 year warranty How to Use the Rangefinder System Rangefinding Measure a known target in MILs or MOA. Rotate the bezel so target size aligns with relative size you measured in your scope on the chapter ring. Read distance at: • 12 o’clock (meters) • 10 o’clock (yards) • 20.5 minutes, or ~4 o'clock (sniper mixed system) Example (Metric) 30 cm target measuring 3 mils → align 30 with 3 → read 100 meters Wind Calculation Point arrow at target direction. Multiply wind speed by displayed factor: 30° = 0.50 45° = 0.71 60° = 0.87 90° = 1.00 MIL to MOA Use inner scale for quick conversion: 8 MIL ≈ 27.5 MOA View this post on Instagram A post shared by North Shadow (@northshadowhq)

watches.description: Adventure Watch with Multi-Function Bezel Lead time: 3–4 weeks O.U.T.C.A.S.T. = Outdoor Utility Timepiece Compass And Survival Tool A mechanical tool watch built for land and water use. Durable construction, a reliable automatic movement, and a multi-function bezel designed to go beyond basic timing. Specifications NH35 automatic movement (hacking, hand-winding) 316 stainless steel case (optional Black PVD) 40mm diameter · 12.8mm thick · 48.5mm lug-to-lug 20mm lug width 200m / 20 ATM water resistance (pressure tested) Sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating BGW9 lume (hands, indices, bezel) 144g / 5oz Laser-etched branding on crown, clasp, and caseback. Custom engraving available for orders of 10 or more. Dial & Orientation Field & sea layout with 24-hour inner track 3/6/9 markers are non-luminous and are d esigned to actually help you orient the watch at night. Build & Kit Screw-link bracelet (no pins) Toolless micro-adjust clasp Included screwdriver for sizing Zippered travel puck case (no fancy presentation box) First Setup Unscrew crown, pull out one click and set the time. Then click it back in and wind it ~50 turns. You cannot overwind it (internal clutch) Bracelet screws: apply blue Loctite (best option) or re-snug all screws and check regularly The watch was pressure checked at the factory but screw the crown in tight to keep everything waterproof. Shipping & Warranty Ships direct or via U.S. routing depending on location Lead time remains 3–4 weeks Covered by 1 year warranty How to Use the Bezel 1. Countdown Timer Set your desired time against the minute hand. As the hand approaches the marker, time is running out. 2. Elapsed Time (Minutes) Align the triangle with the minute hand at the start. Read elapsed minutes as the hand moves. 3. Compass (Northern Hemisphere) Point the hour hand at the sun. Split the angle between the hour hand and 12—this midpoint is south. Rotate the bezel so “S” aligns there. 4. Second Time Zone (12-hour) Rotate the bezel forward or back by your hour offset. Read the second time zone where the hour hand points. 5. Elapsed Time (Hours) Use the hour hand against the bezel’s 12-hour scale to track longer durations. 6. Tide Tracking Set to the last high tide. Advance ~50 minutes per day to stay aligned with the tide cycle (approximate).
